title: LLM isolation X4: a phase agent cannot start an LLM, an evolve dispatch or another agent
summary: A phase pane has dispatch depth 0, so the refusal in evolve agent run (go/internal/cli/agentcmd/run.go:93-94) does not fire. The SBPL preamble allows every exec (go/internal/adapters/sandbox/sandbox.go:149-152). EVOLVE_SANDBOX=off turns the sandbox off inside a phase. Spec: docs/architecture/llm-isolation.md §7, §9 and §23.
fix: Set EVOLVE_DISPATCH_DEPTH=1 and EVOLVE_PHASE on each phase pane. Add a process-exec deny for each manifest binary (SBPL literal, bwrap /dev/null bind). Refuse EVOLVE_SANDBOX=off inside a phase. Keep the private tmux server rows and add a row for kill(-1) (blast radius, spec §23).
acceptance: RED first: matrix row N3 (a phase pane runs claude --version with exit 0) fails before and passes after
Row N4: evolve agent run inside a phase pane is refused
A launch with EVOLVE_SANDBOX=off inside a phase is refused with a named error
In shadow the exec deny reports and emits ISOLATION_I3_VIOLATION; in enforce it denies
Changed functions at 100% coverage; spec §7 and §9 and the sandbox package note updated
